judges.name: Sri P. Suryanarayana Murthy
judges.temperament: Impatient. Hates anything irregular: late filings, missing indexes, unserved copies, repeated adjournments.
habits: refuses documents filed without an index or without serving copies
imposes costs on the third adjournment by the same side

judges.name: Smt. G. Padmavathi
judges.temperament: Gentle and forgiving. Grants time readily, rarely imposes costs, pushes parties towards mediation.
habits: suggests mediation whenever parties are family or old friends
grants a second chance without costs, with a polite warning

opposing_counsel.name: Sri M. Harinath

opposing_counsel.name: Sri V. Harsha Vardhan

opposing_counsel.name: Sri T. Bhaskar

cases.title: Ramesh Gorle vs Srinivas Bandaru
cases.nature: suit for partition and declaration of half share
cases.summary: Ramesh claims half of Ac. 4.20 cents in Sy. No. 112/2, Mangamaripeta village, Bheemunipatnam mandal; Srinivas claims 70% because he says he paid Rs. 21 lakh of the Rs. 30 lakh price.

cases.title: Seabreeze Resorts & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. vs Srinivas Bandaru & Ramesh Gorle
cases.nature: suit for specific performance of agreement of sale dated 18.09.2024
cases.summary: Company sues on an agreement Srinivas alone signed for the whole 4.20 acres; Ramesh never signed.

cases.title: Ramesh Gorle vs Seabreeze Resorts & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.
cases.nature: suit for permanent injunction, with I.A. No. 612 of 2025 for temporary injunction
cases.summary: Company workers put up fencing poles on the land on 14.04.2025; Ramesh sued to stop them.

cases.title: Lakshmi Kantham Peddinti vs Nagaraju Kotla
cases.nature: suit for eviction and arrears of rent
cases.summary: Tenant running 'Sri Durga Tiffins' in the ground-floor shop at Dwaraka Nagar owes 11 months' rent (Rs. 1,98,000).

cases.title: Vijaya Offset Printers vs Greenfield Public School
cases.nature: suit for recovery of Rs. 6,84,500 with interest
cases.summary: Printer supplied textbooks and notebooks for 2023-24; school paid nothing on 14 invoices.
